trap.label: discurso indireto (perguntas)
trap.wrong: She told him she found his letter. He asked where did she find it.
trap.right: She told him she had found his letter. He asked where she had found it.
trap.why: Em português “perguntou onde ela encontrou” segue a ordem normal. O brasileiro, porém, mantém a inversão da pergunta direta. Em inglês, no discurso indireto a ordem é afirmativa e o tempo recua (found → had found).

mcq.q: “I found it.” → She said she ___ it.
“Where did you find it?” → He asked where she ___.
“Do you like tea?” → He asked ___ I liked tea.
Question word order in reported speech:

fix.wrong: He asked where did she live.
She asked if I like tea.
fix.right: She asked if I liked tea.

fix.wrong: He said he saw it before.
fix.right: He said he had seen it before.
